title: Fourier regularity at full dimension
statement: Let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Every nonempty coordinate set of size at most $n$ has Fourier coefficient of absolute value at most $\varepsilon$ if and only if every nonempty coordinate set has Fourier coefficient of absolute value at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
